committee.sub: Morning brief · Thursday 17 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend jumped to A$185.58 over the last 7 days from A$69.93 prior, with clicks up to 29 from 12, but conversions are still 0. Post-restart clicks since 8 Sept sit at 34 of the 150 stop-loss threshold.
Budget lost share (18.2%) remains well below rank lost share (75.7%) over the last 30 days, so the case for more budget still does not stack up. CTR also slipped to 3.5% from 4.9%.
Sessions last7 rose to 51 from 34, but calculator.usedLast7 is still 0, unchanged from prior7. The ungated calculator step in the funnel is not getting used despite more traffic reaching the site.

LinkedIn sessions are flat at 0 for both periods despite Chris continuing to post there, which points to untagged links rather than no traffic. Organic Search held steady at 7 sessions, still the only unpaid channel worth trusting, and remains small.

actions.text: Add logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the ad groups currently serving.
Fix the homepage form so kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree confirm rather than before it, so lead counts reflect verified submissions.
Update RSA description D1, which still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, to match the current site stats.
